title: Enchanted Green Dog
description: A vibrant green dog with spiral patterns and orange eyes stands in profile wearing a pink banana-patterned collar. Behind it flows a mystical river with glowing lotus flowers and circular portals, leading toward a dark red eclipse sky where a demonic figure stirs a cauldron surrounded by witches, ghosts, and shadowy spirits.
prompt: A vibrant lime green dog in profile with hypnotic spiral patterns on its fur and orange spiral eyes, wearing a bright pink collar covered in yellow bananas. The dog stands beside a magical glowing river filled with lotus flowers and circular portals under a dramatic sky featuring a blood red solar eclipse. In the background a demonic red figure with a halo stirs a bubbling cauldron as witches, ghosts and shadowy spirits float around in a dark fantasy landscape.
